summary: Viktor is an AI coworker for Slack and Microsoft Teams with integrations, automation, reports, code and PR reviews. The current Free-plan card offers up to $100 in one-time starter credits for a new workspace without a credit card or upfront paid subscription; the actual award depends on how the workspace signed up and must be checked on its Billing page. Free credits never expire. Joining an existing workspace does not establish a separate starter award for each user. The pricing Team card lists $100/month, while Plans and Credits docs list paid choices from $50/month and note that some workspaces have a $100 minimum. The pricing headline/FAQ and older promotional quotes still say $100, but do not override the qualified Free-plan card and signup-dependent documentation. No enrollment deadline or account-specific grant was verified in the 2026-10-14 copy check.
claim_steps: Join your team or add Viktor to Slack or Microsoft Teams.

Finish the setup wizard, then check the free starter-credit balance on the intended workspace's Billing page. New-workspace credits are a one-time award of up to $100 and depend on signup path; do not assume each member joining an existing workspace receives $100.
Free credits never expire. When the workspace's starter credits run out, Viktor pauses until you choose a paid plan; check the workspace's plan picker for its available paid options.
